_comment: Brands the comparison tool pulls from. Pulls every product via each store's public Shopify /products.json (no key needed). Unlike tested-products.json, there's NO testing gate here — this is a browse/compare tool, not a Remy-tested endorsement. affiliate_url is used as-is (no code to apply) unless the brand has a partner deal like Pack Leashes/Brooks & Roo.

west-paw.name: West Paw
west-paw._note: Has its own AvantLink affiliate program (10%, 30-day window, requires 6mo+ site history). Not yet applied — direct link only until approved.

mighty-paw.name: Mighty Paw
mighty-paw._note: Runs its own affiliate program (see mightypaw.com footer). Already reviewed once on the blog (bully sticks). Apply when ready.

sodapup.name: SodaPup
sodapup._note: Verified Shopify (variant-refresh behavior on own site; resellers confirm 'Powered by Shopify'). Fills Toys, Chews, and Feeding all at once — lick mats, slow feeders, treat dispensers, chew toys. No affiliate program found yet — check for one before applying.

sniff-and-bark.name: Sniff & Bark
sniff-and-bark._note: Ambassador deal: 10% commission on REMYSLAB20 sales. Confirmed real Shopify store (women-owned, Vancouver-founded, now Massachusetts-based) selling collars, leashes, harnesses, bandanas, coats, poop bag holders. Should fill Bandanas & Accessories, Harnesses, Leashes, and Collars.
